text:
rachel-ops: Heads-up: Nebula N100 dedicated pools will be in a rotating beta window in sao-paulo-3 and dublin-2 starting 2026-05-10 14:00 UTC. For validation and non-prod experiments only. Do NOT migrate production yet.

liang-eng: Specs? memory / perf vs H100p?

rachel-ops: N100: 96GB VRAM, native sparsity, FP16 ~1.4x H100p (internal prelim). Docs and bench link will follow.

ops-bot: pools/nebula-n100 = "rotational-beta". Warm window = 3h, preemptible cap = 25%. Reservations outside warm window go to cold queue with lower placement priority.

liang-eng: Any difference in reservation semantics?

rachel-ops: Reservations with --priority high still not guaranteed on beta pools. Fairshare weights apply as usual. Use reserved buckets for production SLOs post-GA.

tara-sre: Infra note: N100 racks run ~12kW. If thermals/power trips, tag @tara-sre and escalate to #eng-oncall. Runbook: intranet/redwood/runbooks/nebula-n100 (internal).

kevin-product: Billing tag: nebula-beta-may2026. Include in reservation metadata; Console filter coming tomorrow.

rachel-ops: CLI example:
# reserve 1 GPU in nebula-n100 pool in sao-paulo-3 for 2h starting 2026-05-10T14:00Z
rdrctl reserve --pool nebula-n100 --region sao-paulo-3 --count 1 --start 2026-05-10T14:00Z --duration 2h --meta "charge=nebula-beta-may2026"

ops-bot: Reservation confirmed (id:46789) for liang-eng.

legal-bot: Reminder: do NOT process regulated customer data in beta pools until compliance sign-off.

sofia-ps: Partner guide & opt-in checklist will be posted EOD.

rachel-ops: If you hit regressions, open a ticket with tag "nebula-n100-beta" and paste traces here. We'll monitor and pause the window if needed. :eyes:
